experiments.scope: The 39-step compression and advice construction of sha256-r39-prefix-v1 as used by the construction (proof.md Sections 2, 10 and 11). Trial 0 runs the shipped program's Attack.claw on the published Table 23 pair (chaining value CV_PUB, a0 = A[4], u = W1) with the folded kernel built for CV_PUB, and runs verify_advice_construction(): the exact 32-bit bit-by-bit DFS fibre solver solve_row_exact on row 16 (G16) and row 17 (G17(g)), exact downward step inversion from steps 10..15 to CV_PUB (invert_downward), and enumeration of a 256-candidate local slice of the step-15 free bits. Trials 1 to 255 draw a chaining value, an even a0 and an odd u from the trial seed, recover a1, build the first message and its partner from the construction, and compare the 39-step trajectories of both with the published pair. Every trial output is verified by hard assert statements in r39joint.py.
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r39joint.py._e1 (capped at <= 16 keys per trial). Trial 0 (16 keys): claw_returned_pair 1, passed_f9 1, passed_f8 1, passed_w17 1, pair_is_published 1, sfs_collision 1, published_w16_is_g 1, published_w17 1, kernel_records 734, claw_ops 6173, blk_census 149, g16_fibre_size 2, g17_fibre_size 1, fibre_dfs_ops 1944 (< 2812 = 1 compression), advice_slice_hits 1, ops_per_cand 408 (< 4 * 2812 = 4 compressions). Trial 1 (10 keys) additionally reports all 7 verify_advice_construction() keys including downward_inv_ok 1 and advice_slice_cands 256 alongside transplant_ok 1, w1_is_u 1, w16_identity 1. Trials 1 to 255: transplant_ok 1 (the states A[6..19] and E[10..19] of both messages equal the published ones), w1_is_u 1, w16_identity 1 (W16 - g = F(u) - F(a0) mod 2^32) on all 255.

experiments.scope: Trials 0 to 3 run 4 independent windows of the shipped program (folded 256-lane kernel, every parameter of class P unchanged: DP = low 7 bits zero, table 26,112 words, queue 4096, stage 2 as in proof.md Section 3) on 4 first blocks drawn from the organizer trial seeds, cut to 2^22 walk evaluations (16,384 iterations of 256 lanes) each = 2^24 walk evaluations total (3,265 distinct claws and 3,265 distinct claw groups), in check mode: every raw claw is asserted to satisfy F(a0) = F(u), a0 even, u odd and W16 = g by build and expand, and every distinct claw and group is checked for F8, F9, W17 low-8/12-bit matches, 100% distinct (W8, W9, W17, W18) tuples, 256-bin chi-square uniformity of W17 mod 2^8 and W18 mod 2^8, and lag-1 group autocorrelation of (W9 in F9, W17[0], W18[0]).
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r39joint.py (WIN_EXP and serve()): across trials 0..3 (2^24 walk evaluations), distinct_claws = [807, 827, 795, 836] (3,265 total), distinct_groups = [807, 827, 795, 836] (3,265 total, ratio 1.0000), dp_hits = [32865, 32680, 32802, 32979], matches = [1705, 1775, 1676, 1668], raw_claws = [836, 863, 829, 868], passed_f9 = [11, 12, 12, 20] (55 total vs 51.8 expected), passed_f8 = [0, 0, 1, 1] (2 joint F9 & F8 passes vs 3.64 expected), f8_all = [50, 74, 56, 44] (224 total vs 229.6 expected), w17_low8 = [3, 0, 2, 6] (11 total vs 12.75 expected), w17_low12 = [0, 0, 0, 2] (2 total vs 0.80 expected), kernel_records = [741, 719, 726, 692], ops = [24291337, 23888938, 23955125, 23329573], blk_census reaching 734. Across all 3,265 groups, serve() asserts 256-bin chi-square of W17 mod 256 is 239.57 (255 df) and W18 mod 256 is 248.67 (255 df), and lag-1 autocorrelation of (W9 in F9, W17[0], W18[0]) is < 0.02 (-0.0165, 0.0116, 0.0020).

experiments.scope: Tail replica of proof Section 8 (run 1 of 14): trial 0 runs verify_smc_stats() (hard-asserting stage-18 direct Monte Carlo calibration c18 = 206/65536 and Del Moral Feynman-Kac linear-scale unbiased estimator bounds across all 14 runs in EXP) and the SMC over E18..E23 of the carrier K_P (800 particles) with a known-answer check on the published pair; trials 1 to 10 draw W8 in F8 and W9 in F9 for every proposal (80 x 2048 each), rebuild rows 24 to 38 and verify every hit by the two 39-step compressions, asserting exact match with EXP['r39-tail-01'].
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r39tail.py (EXP and verify_smc_stats()): kat == 1, mask_viol == 0, calib_c18 == 206, lin_lcb_ok == 1, stage counts k18..k23, log2_carrier, and per-trial verified collision hits match EXP['r39-tail-01']. Across all 14 runs in EXP: 1,706 verified collisions in 22,937,600 proposals, parity classes [427, 440, 433, 406] (chi-square 1.51 < 7.81), linear-scale unbiased mean log2(mean(Q')) = -75.3284 (-75.328), and one-sided 99% Student-t lower bound log2(lcb_lin) = -75.5062 (-75.506) > -75.53 (and even log-scale Jensen-biased 99% lower bound -75.5116 > -75.53).
